$comment: CAT-F floor-to-real transition, Primary app root. The installed floor version has no service manifest; the real candidate does. Transaction selection must read both manifests plus the stable package id and must not assume an installed package without a service is a non-service package.

installed.note: No 'service' object at all -- this is CAT-F's inert floor pak, not a disabled service.

expected_outcome.action: Ordinary P1 promote: move floor tree aside, promote real tree, commit install record. TXN-1 quiescence proof is trivially satisfied because the floor pak never had a service.
expected_outcome.post_state: service.id org.umrk.syncthing now discoverable and startable; default_enabled remains false so the user must explicitly enable it.
